facts.claim: The Enhanced Extern Program helps Ontario hospitals offer clinical learners employment as externs, giving students paid, hands-on work in hospitals.
facts.quote: By offering paid, hands-on work in hospitals, students get to step into the heart of health care

facts.claim: Externs work in unregulated care provider roles, under the supervision of regulated health care professionals.
facts.quote: These externs, working under the supervision of regulated health care professionals, contribute in unregulated care provider roles

facts.claim: Thousands of students take part in the extern program, which provides over 4.5 million hours of coverage annually.
facts.quote: sees thousands of students participating in the extern program and provides over 4.5 million hours of coverage annually

facts.claim: Each year, students are matched with hospitals twice: once in October and again in February.
facts.quote: Each year, students are matched with hospitals twice – once in October and again in February

facts.claim: The program is gradually including more allied health students, such as those in physiotherapy, occupational therapy and respiratory therapy.
facts.quote: the gradual inclusion of more allied health students – like those in physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and respiratory therapy

facts.claim: According to Ontario Health, hospitals are hiring externs for permanent positions.
facts.quote: Hospitals are hiring externs for permanent positions, strengthening their teams for the long term.
